violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Discard Single-Service Items (26 TAC §746.3317(4))
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Discard Single-Service Items
violation_type.typical_finding: There were two left over bowls with cereal on the table which were accessible to the children in the classroom.     Corrected at Inspection: The bowls were removed.

finding_variants.text: There were two left over bowls with cereal on the table which were accessible to the children in the classroom.     Corrected at Inspection: The bowls were removed.

Single-use disposable foam cups were labeled with each child's name in the afterschool room. According to the caregiver the children reuse the same disposable cup through out the day.      Note: This was addressed during inspection and the labeled foam cups were discarded.
Several unlabeled disposable juice bottles were observed in a bucket in the freezer. According to the caregiver, they are used to serve water to the children.
